nodes.description: Public view function that checks whether an address is a contract by reading its deployed bytecode size.
Address parameter whose code size is inspected; passed directly into inline assembly.
Uninitialized local uint assigned from the extcodesize opcode inside the assembly block.
Inline assembly block invoking extcodesize(addr); low-level EVM opcode usage bypasses Solidity type/return checks.

edges.reason: The address parameter addr is supplied to the public function isContract and consumed by its body.
Execution of isContract unconditionally enters the inline assembly block that performs the extcodesize query.
The extcodesize opcode result is written into the local variable size, so data flows from the unsafe operation to the local variable.
The local variable size is compared (size > 0) and returned as the function's bool result.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter addr has no independent identity outside the function call boundary; it is fully described by the function signature it belongs to.
Local variable size exists solely to capture the extcodesize assembly output, so it is subsumed by that unsafe operation node.
